One row = 3 ints = 12 bytes.

- x + 3 = address of row 3 = 2000 + 3 [latex]\times[/latex] 12 = 2036
- *(x + 3) = address of x[3][0] = 2036
- *(x + 2) + 3 = address of x[2][0] + 3 ints = 2024 + 12 = 2036

Answer: 2036, 2036, 2036
